name: verify-dependency-exists
description: Allowlist gate for new dependencies; no registry lookup is made. Reads Python, Node, Rust, Ruby, PHP, JVM, .NET, Go, Elixir, Dart and Swift manifests (read, never run); blocks an added name missing from .chock/dependency-allowlist.txt and asks on a lockfile-only addition. Not read: computed lists, sources, some pattern-read forms (see docs), versions. Opt-in: seed the allowlist, run in rollout observe, then `chock enable verify-dependency-exists`. Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end.
